hook: The calmest day to fly is *Thanksgiving*.
dek: Fares are the highest in a decade. Here's the day-by-day calendar for Thanksgiving 2026 and the move that saves you money.
title: Thanksgiving Fares Are the Highest in a Decade. Here's How to Fly Smarter.
yt_title: Thanksgiving 2026: Best and Worst Days to Fly

slides.label: The fare
slides.text: Hopper's average domestic Thanksgiving round trip: *$402*, up *31%* and the *highest in ten years*.

slides.label: The crowd
slides.text: The Sunday after Thanksgiving 2025 was the *busiest day in TSA history*: about *3.13 million* screened.

slides.label: Avoid
slides.text: *Wed Nov 25* is the priciest outbound. *Sun Nov 29* is the likely record day.

slides.label: The move
slides.text: Fly out *Thanksgiving morning*. Come home *Tue Dec 1* or *Wed Dec 2*.

slides.label: Dec 1
slides.text: *Travel Tuesday*: Hopper says select hotels up to *50% off*. Book 2027 then.
